dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Oh! So many books... including some antiques that I've never laid eyes on before! Wow, just skimming through a few pages, I'm already captivated...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Here, give me your hand. You've earned some candies. As for any questions you may have for me, or anything you want to bring to my attention... hold them for later.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Just let me peruse these treasures for a little while...
